ruleset_status: Four Against the Abyss runtime tables: room content plus playable Abyss monster/event routing. Detailed one-off effects remain summarized unless already covered by generalized monster hooks.

abyss_room_content_table.name: Abyss Treasure
abyss_room_content_table.summary: Roll on the Abyss Treasure table; on d6=6 the treasure is guarded by an Abyss Boss.

abyss_room_content_table.name: Abyss Trap and Treasure
abyss_room_content_table.summary: Roll on the Abyss Traps table and Abyss Treasure table.

abyss_room_content_table.name: Abyss Unique Event
abyss_room_content_table.summary: Roll on the Abyss Unique Events table.

abyss_room_content_table.name: Abyss Special Feature
abyss_room_content_table.summary: Corridor is empty; room rolls on Abyss Special Feature table.

abyss_room_content_table.name: Abyss Vermin
abyss_room_content_table.summary: Roll on the Abyss Vermin table.

abyss_room_content_table.name: Abyss Minions
abyss_room_content_table.summary: Roll on the Abyss Minions table.

abyss_room_content_table.name: Abyss Minions or Empty
abyss_room_content_table.summary: Corridor is empty; room rolls on Abyss Minions table.

abyss_room_content_table.name: Abyss Empty / Unique Event
abyss_room_content_table.summary: Empty; on d6=5-6 roll a not-yet-used Abyss Unique Event, otherwise searchable.

abyss_room_content_table.name: Abyss Trap or Weird Monster
abyss_room_content_table.summary: Corridor rolls on Abyss Traps; room rolls on Abyss Weird Monsters.

abyss_room_content_table.name: Abyss Boss
abyss_room_content_table.summary: Room rolls on Abyss Boss table; final-boss check uses d6 plus defeated bosses.

abyss_room_content_table.name: Abyss Boss or Dragon
abyss_room_content_table.summary: Corridor empty; regular room treats as boss result, large room is a dragon lair.

abyss_vermin_table.name: Black Orc Bandits
abyss_vermin_table.summary: Level 6 bandits; normal treasure; bribe or fight.

abyss_vermin_table.name: Shrieking Fungi
abyss_vermin_table.summary: Do not attack; spells at -1; immune to Sleep; Fireball at -1 (net -2); wandering monsters arrive if not killed within 2 turns and surprise the party. Reroll when generated as wandering monsters.

abyss_vermin_table.name: Ant People Warriors
abyss_vermin_table.summary: Chemical marker can impose -1 Defense against ant people until Blessing or immersion.

abyss_vermin_table.name: Kobold Ghouls
abyss_vermin_table.summary: Undead; wounded heroes save vs poison or become paralyzed until Blessing/end of combat.

abyss_vermin_table.name: Brownies
abyss_vermin_table.summary: Morale -1; feed on gold each turn; treasure is gems/magic rather than coins.

abyss_minions_table.name: Hairy Goblins
abyss_minions_table.summary: 1-in-6 chance of a level 10 goblin leader; trial of champions possible.

abyss_minions_table.name: Abyss Ghouls
abyss_minions_table.summary: Undead; 1-in-6 chance of a Ghoul King leader; wounded heroes save vs poison or paralysis.

abyss_minions_table.name: Dark Dwarves
abyss_minions_table.summary: Two treasure rolls; 2-in-6 chance to ignore Sleep for the whole group.

abyss_minions_table.name: Flying Skulls
abyss_minions_table.summary: Crushing +1; arrows -2; natural 1 melee can disarm the attacker.

abyss_minions_table.name: Chaotic Ratmen
abyss_minions_table.summary: Leader present; infected blades can cause an extra wound at encounter end.

abyss_minions_table.name: Chaos Fanatics
abyss_minions_table.summary: Morale +1; 2-in-6 chance of a Dark Lord of Xichtul leader.

abyss_boss_table.name: Dragon Man
abyss_boss_table.summary: First turn dragon fire: all heroes save vs L8 or lose 1 Life; then claw attacks.

abyss_boss_table.name: Mind Screamer
abyss_boss_table.summary: 3-in-6 surprise; mental bolts ignore armor/shields and inflict Madness.

abyss_boss_table.name: Tentacled Brain
abyss_boss_table.summary: Floats above melee; it is L6 to ranged weapons or spells. Before every party action, all heroes save vs L5 or lose 1 Life and gain 1 Madness; wizards add +L. It makes no normal attacks. Reactions: 1-2 flee, 3-4 bribe 300gp, 5-6 fight.

abyss_boss_table.name: Ghoul King
abyss_boss_table.summary: Undead; wounded heroes save vs poison or paralysis; fights to death.

abyss_boss_table.name: Dark Lord of Xichtul
abyss_boss_table.summary: Hits inflict 2 damage; natural 1 Defense can destroy a shield.

abyss_boss_table.name: Major Vampire
abyss_boss_table.summary: Vampire restrictions; damage can cause level loss.

abyss_weird_table.name: Zombie Minotaur
abyss_weird_table.summary: Defense rolls against it are at -1.

abyss_weird_table.name: Giant Constrictor Snake
abyss_weird_table.summary: Failed Defense constricts for 1 Life per turn until killed or escaped.

abyss_weird_table.name: Minor Vampire
abyss_weird_table.summary: Vampire restrictions; damage can cause level loss.

abyss_weird_table.name: Werewolf
abyss_weird_table.summary: Silver +1; wounded heroes save vs L5 infection for lycanthropy at encounter end.

abyss_weird_table.name: Phasing Panther
abyss_weird_table.summary: Always attacks first; each hit: d6 4+ blink away and ignore that wound. Reactions: always fight.

abyss_weird_table.name: Lich
abyss_weird_table.summary: Meeting it causes Madness; fear save can impose -1 Attack; possible skeletal warriors.

abyss_dragon_table.name: Purple Dragon
abyss_dragon_table.summary: Electrical blast can wound heavy-armor wearers.

abyss_dragon_table.name: Luck Dragon
abyss_dragon_table.summary: Slaying it grants surviving heroes 1 temporary Luck point.

abyss_dragon_table.name: Ghoul Dragon
abyss_dragon_table.summary: Undead; wounded heroes save vs poison or paralysis.

abyss_dragon_table.name: Young Chaos Dragon
abyss_dragon_table.summary: Blessing can adjust its reaction roll; varied reaction outcomes.

Abyss Shrieking Fungi.result: The shrieking fungi stand and shriek.

abyss_trap_table.name: Dart Shooting Mechanism
abyss_trap_table.summary: Level d8+3 trap attacks one random hero; failed poison save can inflict 2 wounds.

abyss_trap_table.name: Giant Metal Ball
abyss_trap_table.summary: Spiked ball attacks all heroes; room level 7, corridor level 9.

abyss_trap_table.name: Crocodile Pit Trapdoor
abyss_trap_table.summary: Random hero may fall into a pit with a level 7 spiked crocodile.

abyss_trap_table.name: Guillotine
abyss_trap_table.summary: Level d6+2 blade; failed save deals 3 wounds.

abyss_trap_table.name: Electrical Blast
abyss_trap_table.summary: All heroes save vs level 7 electricity or take 1 wound.

abyss_trap_table.name: Steel Spear
abyss_trap_table.summary: Marching-order dodge/block sequence; failures take d3 wounds.

abyss_treasure_table.summary: d8 x 5 gp or one non-magical weapon.
4d6 x 10 gp or one Useful Stuff item.
Scroll with a random Abyss spell.
Jewelry worth 4d6 x 15 gp or one Useful Stuff item.
One random Abyss magic treasure item.
Magical defense item or 4d6 x 25 gp.

abyss_magic_treasure_table.name: Amulet of Protection versus Undead
abyss_magic_treasure_table.summary: +1 Defense and saves against undead attacks; resale 250gp.

abyss_magic_treasure_table.name: Medallion of Snake Charming
abyss_magic_treasure_table.summary: d8+L can make snakes or lizardmen minions friendly; resale 100gp.

abyss_magic_treasure_table.name: Parchment of Banishing
abyss_magic_treasure_table.summary: Wizard/cleric scroll; 2 wounds to one undead or demon, then dust.

abyss_magic_treasure_table.name: Baton of Righteousness
abyss_magic_treasure_table.summary: Crushing hand weapon; heals 1 Life when it kills a boss or weird monster; resale 250gp.

abyss_magic_treasure_table.name: Philter of Fire Breathing
abyss_magic_treasure_table.summary: One encounter dragon-fire immunity plus one breath attack; resale 80gp.

abyss_magic_treasure_table.name: Ring of Three Wishes
abyss_magic_treasure_table.summary: d3 wishes for reroll, monster damage, non-magical treasure/equipment, basic spell, or full wearer healing.

abyss_magical_defense_table.name: Ring of Defense
abyss_magical_defense_table.summary: +1 Defense; only one ring of defense may be worn.

abyss_magical_defense_table.name: Cross against Vampires
abyss_magical_defense_table.summary: +2 Defense against vampires; only one may be worn.

abyss_magical_defense_table.name: Brownie Ward
abyss_magical_defense_table.summary: Brownies immediately make a morale roll when encountered.

abyss_magical_defense_table.name: Magic Shield
abyss_magical_defense_table.summary: +2 Defense shield, indestructible; usable by shield-eligible characters.

abyss_magical_defense_table.name: Elfin Chain Mail
abyss_magical_defense_table.summary: Light armor with +2 Defense; non-magical, so barbarians may wear it.

abyss_magical_defense_table.name: Suit of Enchanted Armor
abyss_magical_defense_table.summary: Heavy armor with +3 Defense; adapts to wearer size.

abyss_special_feature_table.name: Enchanted Banquet
abyss_special_feature_table.summary: Heroes may eat; each eater rolls on the Enchanted Banquet table.

abyss_special_feature_table.name: Lava River
abyss_special_feature_table.summary: A random magic item is across a lava river; leap out and back or suffer wounds.

abyss_special_feature_table.name: Room of Horrors
abyss_special_feature_table.summary: All heroes gain Madness and save vs fear or suffer -1 Attack until Blessing.

abyss_special_feature_table.name: Chained Monster
abyss_special_feature_table.summary: A random Abyss boss is imprisoned; leave, kill without reward, or free it for gold and a Clue.

abyss_special_feature_table.name: Repository of Secret Knowledge
abyss_special_feature_table.summary: Research risks wandering monsters; one hero gains a Clue and may gain Madness.

abyss_special_feature_table.name: Puzzle Room
abyss_special_feature_table.summary: Puzzle box level d8+4; failed attempts cost Life or Madness; success rolls treasure.

abyss_unique_event_table.name: Book of Secrets
abyss_unique_event_table.summary: A chosen reader gains d6 Clues but saves vs Clues+2 or gains d3 Madness.

abyss_unique_event_table.name: Dark Plague
abyss_unique_event_table.summary: Random hero saves vs L10 disease or contracts Dark Plague; infected heroes roll d8 each room and spread saves to non-immune allies.

abyss_unique_event_table.name: Swarm of Critters
abyss_unique_event_table.summary: Fireball disperses it; otherwise all heroes take 1 wound.

abyss_unique_event_table.name: Secret Stairs
abyss_unique_event_table.summary: Secret passage to an upper-level room/corridor, with possible wandering monster.

abyss_unique_event_table.name: Gold Ghost
abyss_unique_event_table.summary: Sacrifice 100 gp or all heroes suffer -1 Defense until individually Blessed.

abyss_unique_event_table.name: Mana Sink
abyss_unique_event_table.summary: Spellcasters save per spell vs power 7 mana sink or lose spells; one-time room effect.

abyss_enchanted_banquet_table.name: Magical Food
abyss_enchanted_banquet_table.summary: Heal 3 Life, then fey steals d6xd6 gp or valuables; curse with magical bells if nothing valuable.

abyss_enchanted_banquet_table.name: Spoiled Lamb
abyss_enchanted_banquet_table.summary: Save vs L7 poison or suffer -1 Attack for next two encounters.

abyss_enchanted_banquet_table.name: Ghost Food
abyss_enchanted_banquet_table.summary: Save vs L6 magic or gain 1 Madness.

abyss_enchanted_banquet_table.name: That's My Food
abyss_enchanted_banquet_table.summary: Unique two-headed ogre attacks with surprise; silverware worth 100gp.

abyss_enchanted_banquet_table.name: Fey Food
abyss_enchanted_banquet_table.summary: Gain one random basic spell until cast; barbarians ignore.

abyss_useful_stuff_table.name: Rope, lantern, or hand weapon
abyss_useful_stuff_table.summary: Choose rope, lantern, or one slashing/crushing hand weapon.

abyss_useful_stuff_table.name: Blessed Stakes
abyss_useful_stuff_table.summary: d6 blessed stakes count as magic weapons against vampires only.

abyss_useful_stuff_table.name: Wolvesbane
abyss_useful_stuff_table.summary: Thrown at wolf/were-creature to force morale; resale 10gp.

abyss_useful_stuff_table.name: Silver Weapon
abyss_useful_stuff_table.summary: Silver slashing hand weapon or dagger; +1 vs werewolves; resale 20gp.

abyss_useful_stuff_table.name: Blessed Horseshoe
abyss_useful_stuff_table.summary: Reroll one die roll, then spent; resale 10gp unused.

abyss_useful_stuff_table.name: Elven Bread
abyss_useful_stuff_table.summary: d3 loaves; heal 1 Life or remove Dark Plague and grant plague immunity, elves heal 3 Life; resale 10gp each.
